Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add multi-AI provider support \(OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini\)

The PDF File Analyzer now supports 3 AI providers instead of only
Anthropic. Users can select their provider, override the model, and
API keys are stored per-provider in localStorage.

- Create api/providers.js with shared callProvider\(\), system prompts,
  and PROVIDER_DEFAULTS \(eliminates 3x prompt duplication\)
- Update api/analyze.js, api/generate.js, server/server.js to use
  the shared provider module with provider/model from request body
- Add provider dropdown, model input, and dynamic API key label to
  the File Analyzer UI \(index.html, styles.css\)
- Add per-provider key storage with legacy fallback and dynamic UI
  updates on provider switch \(app.js\)
- Install openai and @google/generative-ai dependencies

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix OpenAI provider compatibility and improve error messages

Use max_completion_tokens instead of deprecated max_tokens for newer
OpenAI models \(GPT-5.2+\), update openai SDK to v6, and surface actual
server error messages in the frontend instead of generic failures.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
